Class Powerup

DynamicRectangleEntity
org.example.entities.objects.powerups.Powerup
Direct Known Subclasses:
ExtraLifePowerup, WiderPaddlePowerup
public abstract class Powerup extends DynamicRectangleEntity
Abstract base class for all falling powerups. Handles shared movement, collision logic, and cleanup behavior.
